_about: Bluetooth drivers built by bluetooth/build.py. version and note go into the kext; source_date_epoch fixes Lilu's build date so a rebuild is byte-identical; installed_version and installed_sha256 are the driver in the EFI now (update both after an install) (build.py reports whether the build matches it). Change version, note and source_date_epoch together for a new release.

bluetoolfixup.note: Sequoia 24G824 and 24H241: BE201 A2DP clock, identity, single-advertisement LE, address pause, LE baseline, probe and recent RPA routing; -be201btstock turns them off; Sequoia (Darwin 24) only

intelbtpatcher.note: Sequoia: BE201 switches on by default (probe, native address, LE baseline); -be201btstock turns them off; Sequoia (Darwin 24) only
